description: This PHP test file defines a unit test class 'ElasticSearchInstallTest' that extends an abstract test class. It contains two test methods: one to verify the presence of specific hooks for ElasticSearch in the application's hook system, and another to check that ElasticSearch configuration settings are present in the global configuration array.

classes.name: ElasticSearchInstallTest
classes.description: A unit test class for verifying ElasticSearch hook registration and configuration in the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: testHooksPresent
methods.description: Tests whether the ElasticSearch related hooks are correctly registered in the system.

methods.name: testConfigPresent
methods.description: Tests whether the ElasticSearch configuration parameters are present in the global configuration array.
